title: Align topbar lifecycle static contract
summary: Updates the cross-page static contract to cover the current topbar stage-primary and stage-context lifecycle helpers.
reason: The test still expected the removed topbarCleanCurrentName helper even though the intentionally shipped lifecycle renders normalized stage primary text and contextual stage metadata.
behavior_before: The static contract required a deleted topbarCleanCurrentName helper and failed before it could verify the intended topbar lifecycle behavior.
behavior_after: The static contract requires topbarStagePrimaryText and topbarStageContext, which drive the current topbar activity rendering.
manual_validation: RED: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static_cross_page.ApplicationFacadeWebStaticCrossPageTests.test_shared_app_shell_workflow_handoffs_are_namespace_owned failed because topbarCleanCurrentName is no longer served.
rollback_plan: Revert the static expectations if the topbar lifecycle contract intentionally changes; no production behavior is modified.
notes: Test-only contract alignment; no generated artifacts or production WebView files are changed.
